Hiring, components and project management can become constraints when demand rises quickly. Investors should prefer commercially disciplined execution to an assumption that strategic importance guarantees favorable terms. named_minor_fixes.rationale: Place existing security/procurement discussion under Geopolitics & Security without changing facts.
